summary: Spread seat lease renewals across the minute instead of sending every one in the same second

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Each driver still renews every claimed step once a minute with the same request and idempotency key.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Claim authority, lease length (ten minutes), order and commit-before-ACK are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Driver-side timing only. A driver started before this release keeps renewing on the minute boundary until it restarts.

manual.detail: No manual step. Running seats pick it up when their driver restarts.

recovery.detail: Revert the driver change. A renewal that lands up to 49 s later in the minute cannot expire a ten-minute lease renewed every minute.
